_about: Weights for the offline rules engine (rules_agent.decide). Risk points come from red/amber signals, trust points from green ones. Deterministic red signals skip the arithmetic and always give likely_scam. Tune against `scamcheck eval --mode baseline`; every change should be justified by the eval, not by a single example.

thresholds._note: net = risk - trust. net >= suspicious_net_risk -> suspicious (medium). A non-deterministic red plus pressure language -> likely_scam (medium).
